geopolitics_summary: Europe faces record summer heat crushing growth; gas storage risks winter supply; US LNG production at record highs easing global LNG arb.

themes.headline: Germany's gas reserves critically low ahead of winter heating season
themes.why_it_matters: Low EU storage heading into winter forces higher winter curve pricing (Cal+1, Cal+2) and increases LNG import demand. TTF forward volatility risk if storage fill fails August–September.

themes.headline: French nuclear production hit by recurring jellyfish invasions, summer constraint continues
themes.why_it_matters: Repeated summer outages at French reactors reduce baseload supply, forcing gas-fired displacement. Recurring pattern suggests sustained summer supply gap pushing day-ahead spreads and gas-to-power switching margins wider.

themes.headline: Record US natural gas production 122.5 Bcf/d in 2026 boosts LNG export capacity
themes.why_it_matters: Higher US LNG supply increases global LNG flows available for European arbitrage, weakening TTF via lower LNG import economics. Reduces winter premium in EU gas curve if supply reaches Atlantic.

themes.headline: Europe's scorching summer erodes economic output, dampening power demand growth
themes.why_it_matters: Contraction in France, stalled Dutch growth reduces industrial and commercial demand, weakening Cal+1 forward power prices. Offset partially by AC cooling load, but net macro drag on peak power.

themes.headline: Italy commits billions to green and defence spending under relaxed EU fiscal rules
themes.why_it_matters: Southern EU capex boost on renewables and grids may accelerate capacity additions, medium-term supply-side relief. Fiscal loosening could also stoke inflation and cost pressures on near-term power contracts.

watchlist: EU gas storage fill rate through August–September; winter storage adequacy announcement expected.
French nuclear units resumption timelines post-summer; coolant availability constraints.
US Senate–House reconciliation on Russia sanctions bill; potential indirect LNG / energy trade impacts.
France 2027 blackout drill outcome; regulatory changes to power-grid resilience or emergency dispatch protocols.
